limitations: The manual Add Hidden Network route targets a broadcast open synthetic AP; hidden beacons and WPA association are unverified.
Saving uses genuine HTTP POST /api/wifi, not the conditional nonempty-password UI SAVE_PROMPT branch.
Each reconnect starts fresh pinned full flash and consumes the preceding guest-written SD; it verifies SD credential persistence rather than flash/NVS persistence.
Cancel asserts the credential remains present, not byte-for-byte preservation of the complete intermediate store; no intermediate store snapshot was retained.
The execution snapshots freeze the top-level WiFi and network harnesses only; imported smoke/backend/formatter/runtime dependencies are not frozen in these original receipts.
The --source option records file hashes but does not enforce their relationship to the claimed embedded source commit; this review independently verified all four hashes against git show at that pin.
Four key source dependencies were omitted from the original source list; this derived review pins them and the SDK keyboard table explicitly.
The receipt records HTTP response hashes and readiness result without retaining full response bodies; retained artifacts alone cannot independently reconstruct the device/mode JSON.

The harness searches the full serial log for DHCP rather than a fresh marker; the reviewed Forget receipt has no earlier DHCP success, so the actual recorded flow is sound, but future runs should enforce new attempt/completion counters.
Strict diagnostic validity, RF/physical behavior, and calibrated speed remain false.
